resource.name: orderMapping
resource.content: { id: string(payload.orderId), customer: { name: trim(payload.customer.name), country: payload.customer.country default "NL" }, lines: (payload.lines default []) map (line) -> { sku: upper(line.sku), quantity: number(line.qty) } }

map.name: ReadXML
map.expression: { orderId: attr(payload, "id"), customer: { name: text(child(payload, "Customer")) }, lines: children(payload, "Item") map (item) -> { sku: attr(item, "sku"), qty: attr(item, "quantity") } }
